d: The art and architecture of Ancient Rome was incredibly varied due to the sheer size the empire became. As the Romans expanded and conquered, they embraced the art trends from all over their empire – the Romans adapted and adopted from earlier cultures like the Greeks and Etruscans, as well as others they conquered so it’s not surprising that their art was so varied. The Romans not only created different types of art, but they made it with any and all materials to show their appreciation of the past and commemoration of people and events.
